checks.name: desktop and narrow viewport matrix contains page/sidebar overflow
checks.limitation: Eight widths from 1440 to 320; exact CLI copy remains covered by prior evidence.

checks.name: reaction row opens by keyboard and Escape returns to message actions
checks.limitation: Local DOM/keyboard check; no visual reference or assistive technology certification.

checks.name: active run disables history revert control
checks.limitation: Held loopback request; no provider/device call.

checks.name: archived restore preserves complete message and evidence payload
checks.limitation: Local archive/restore transaction; no packaged/cross-device behavior.

checks.name: conversation export has selected scope timestamps raw output and no credentials
checks.limitation: Markdown export scoped to selected chat; loopback fixture only.

checks.name: long coworker name persists after reload and remains selected-only
checks.limitation: One local long profile fixture; no remote sync.

checks.name: theme save persists across reload in light and dark modes
checks.limitation: Local preferences/reload; readability remains a separate visual check.

checks.name: all help entries are useful and feedback storage failure is visible
checks.limitation: Feedback quota failure injected; no external/private-log request.

checks.name: unavailable Find is omitted from help and Ctrl/Cmd+F opens find only in conversation
checks.limitation: Browser-local shortcut check; native browser find is not used when unavailable.

checks.name: evidence pane is readable across resize endpoints and close restores focus
checks.limitation: Endpoint keyboard resize and local evidence content.

checks.name: annotation draft closes without saving and cannot drift
checks.limitation: Discard path only; stale rerun/save-failure need separate runtime hook.

checks.name: every populated Feed entry opens its exact saved message
checks.limitation: Populated local run/evidence entries; provider/device transport is not exercised.
